main.description: Shared Computer Network admins. The removedAt attribute ends an admin's write authority going forward; grants they authored while current remain valid. Un-granting a member is always an explicit revocation record, never a side effect of a roster edit — otherwise removing one admin would silently de-member everyone they ever approved, with nothing in the event log to show for it. So a consumer verifying a grant's author asks whether that DID was a current admin at the grant's grantedAt (on or after addedAt, before any removedAt), not whether they are an admin now.
